cohort: The study included 197 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) whose MRI scans were reviewed.
finding: Preoperative MRI measurement of cesarean scar diverticulum (CSD) size, particularly CSD volume, is effective in evaluating the risk of adverse events during dilatation and curettage (D&C) in patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP).
mod_finding: The findings relate to complications (cesarean scar diverticulum leading to cesarean scar pregnancy) arising from a previous cesarean section, identifying risk factors for adverse events during subsequent dilatation and curettage.
